children: The New York-based Los Tacos No. 1 chain received an investment from TSG Consumer Partners, whose holdings have included Dutch Bros Coffee and Yard House.
Los Tacos opened in 2013 at the Chelsea Market in New York and now has 10 Los Tacos locations in New York, plus Los Mariscos at Chelsea Market.
The chain, which has garnered favorable media coverage for its authenticity, is known for a brief menu that includes carne asada, adobada and nopal and for its standing-only restaurants.

With the TSG Consumer investment, the company seeks to "bring Los Tacos to a wider audience while keeping the food and shops true to its roots." Co-founder and Chief Executive Christian Pineda and Chief Operating Partner Jacobo Ackerman will continue to lead day-to-day operations and strategic decision-making, the company said.
"TSG shares our belief that more cities deserve authentic tacos like these," the company said.
TSG has about $14 billion in assets under management. It invested in Dutch Bros in 2018. The coffee chain went public in 2021.
